values: 一名身手矫健的刺客，能在战斗时切换远程和近战两种战斗模式并会对敌方后排造成巨大威胁。
An Assassin who can switch between ranged attack and melee attack modes during battles, and pose a huge threat to backline enemies.
那么，这次的宝物是什么呢？
What kind of treasure awaits us today?
棒极了，这次的投资不会让您失望哦？
Excellent. A wise investment. As you'll soon see.
这次的胜利，就由我纳入囊中了~
秘密是最美妙的化妆品，总能让人魅力翻倍，你不这么觉得吗？
Mystery is the most beautiful thing a girl could wear. It's more charming than anything else, don't you think?
在白天飞翔的鸟儿真是可爱，不过，夜晚的鸟儿也不差吧。
Some birds flying during the day are cute... but so are some birds that fly at night.
我曾见过许多奇珍，但这些……你很有眼光。
I've encountered many rarities, but I must say... you have a keen eye.
I thank you for this gift.
优雅的白昼与神秘的夜晚，都是她的舞台。
The elegant day and the mysterious night are both her dance floor.
在这支舞结束前，别想逃出她的陷阱。
No one escapes her trap before the dance ends.
秘银贵宾等级提升至11级可领取该皮肤。
I need a break from time to time.
Let's have a cup of tea.
Do you have any exciting plans for the holiday?
Such a clever display of design.
What are your plans for the holiday?
有许多拍卖机构会出重金邀请维拉夫人这样的鉴赏家来参加，以展示自己的专业性。
Auction organizations would willingly pay a hefty sum to have esteemed connoisseurs and appraisers like Lady Vala at their events to showcase their knowledge.
有一件珍宝的真伪让许多鉴赏家争论不休，直到维拉夫人分辨出了它是真货，不久后它就被盗走。

The authenticity of a certain item caused a heated debate among many appraisers until Lady Vala confirmed it as genuine. However, after the auction house was closed that night, it mysteriously disappeared.
维拉夫人常去的旅行目的地都有她的私人行馆。曾有人试图闯入空置的行馆，却被一个黑衣的神秘女性击晕后扔了出去。

Lady Vala has private villas all over Esperia. One time, a burgular broke into a vacant estate of hers but was caught, tied up, and beaten to a pulp by a mysterious woman in black. The burgular was found naked and tied to a palm tree the next day.
“那鸟我见过，可惜没被我逮住，你说为什么这鸟明明是贵族夫人养的，却要到黑市来。”——企图抓鸟的被骑士团逮捕的黑市摊贩。
"Yeah, I saw that bird, but I couldn't catch it. Why would a bird kept by a noble fly all the way down here to the underground market, you tell me?" —Jailed smuggler
自从维拉夫人带着鸟出席各种活动，贵族圈就开始流行起养鸟的风潮。
Since Lady Vala began attending events with her pet birds, feathered pets have become the trend among the gentry. One noble lady even rode a two-legged bird into the palace. It caused quite a stir.
奎城最知名的伞店橱窗里的新款永远都有“已被维拉夫人预订”的小标签。
The show window of the most well-known umbrella store in Oakenfell always has small tags of "Reserved for Lady Vala" on displayed new arrivals.
耀光帝国全境的黑市上长期挂着一则高价悬赏，目标是一个身份不详、使用刺枪的女贼。
An abnormally high bounty is always posted in all the shadowy markets across the Lightbearer Empire for a mysterious female thief armed with a lance-like pistol.
记者曾暗中调查维拉夫人拍品的幕后卖家，却从未成功地查出那些稀世珍宝的来源。

Journalists have tried to find out the identities of the anonymous sellers at Lady Vala's private auctions. However, no one is able to find out the origins of the precious treasures sold at her venue.
根据维拉夫人慈善基金会最近一次公布的善款使用明细，维拉夫人的捐助范围已经覆盖了耀光帝国全境。

According to public information on Lady Vala's charity foundation, donations have been sent to the needy throughout the Lightbearer Empire and even to refugees across its borders. "I now have all the food I need," said a little girl named Favi.
维达夫人慈善基金会的工作人员透露，夫人往往只需要几分钟就能判定一个项目的真伪。

According to staff members at Lady Vala's foundation, she needs only a few minutes to tell if an object is genuine or fake. She once picked up a Relox pocket watch and knew right away that it was counterfeit.
有一首流传甚广的歌谣，大意是小孩子晚上不睡觉，灰烬魔女就会用火焰烧掉他们的眉毛。
There is a popular folk song about the Scarlet Sorceress to the effect that she would burn the eyebrows of the children who refuse to sleep at night.
那个维拉夫人，到底是什么来头……
What's the deal with this Lady Vala...?
